title: Thai Lamb Koftas with Creamy Sauce
description: A flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring lamb koftas served with a creamy sauce. This recipe is perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine lamb, chopped onions, sliced peppers, and salt. Mix well.
3. Form lamb mixture into small koftas.
4. Grill koftas for 4-5 minutes per side or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
6. Add Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
7. Pour in creamy sauce and stir to combine.
8. Serve grilled lamb koftas with the creamy sauce.
9. Serve with Turkish bread on the side.
